en: With Team Rocket in town and the Slowpoke gone, nobody's got the heart for work. Even the kiln's gone cold.
My apprentice took our two Farfetch'd into Ilex Forest to cut wood, and he still isn't back.
That boy. Without wood there's no charcoal, and without charcoal there's no work. I'll go and fetch him myself.
Thanks to you, the boy's back with both birds, and the kiln's burning again. Azalea's charcoal is the best there is!
I'll find wood. Just watch me!
You found both our Farfetch'd! I'd never have got them back on my own. Please, take this. I made it myself.
Charcoal makes Fire-type moves stronger when a Pokémon holds it.
The Farfetch'd are much better at finding good wood than I am. Don't tell my master I said so.
